title: Three Terms and One Short Form
subtitle: 社会平等 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社会平等（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·平等与包容）
meta: 主题语境：社会平等（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·平等与包容）　|　核心词汇：gender　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gender 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the registrar ① recorded a gender that no clerk in the office would have described, and he said the recording was the whole of the term. The ② gender, meaning the entry itself and not the name, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a gender, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ gender in that office had the same short form beside it, and the ④ gender at the far drawer, meaning the entry they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A gender, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the registrar said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gender was the whole of the matter, meaning the category and not the entry. The ⑥ gender, meaning the category and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gender, he said, is either something you record or the only word that means both an entry and a category. He said the category is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ gender had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short form. The ⑧ gender of the whole thing, the registrar wrote in November, was one office and three terms of describing; gender, he said, is either the entry at the far drawer or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gender I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1985 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ gender, my mother said in 1987, is the only one that improves by being described; every gender, she said, is a category that has agreed to look like an entry. She said the category was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 性别（指办公室里每一栏旁边的那一栏）
B. n. 性别（指那一条登记本身，与姓名相对）
C. 固定搭配：record a gender 登记性别
D. n. 性别（指留给孩子们填写的那一栏）
E. n. 性别（抽象总称，指一间办公室的性别登记之事）
F. n. 性别（指方案里写到、被核对过的那一栏）
G. n. 性；（语法的）性（指一件事里人人都填却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 性别身份（抽象总称，指人人都填却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: recorded a gender that no clerk in the office would have described
The gender, meaning the entry itself and not the name
the gender at the far drawer
the gender was the whole of the matter
the gender had become a line in a plan
The gender of the whole thing
A gender, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: record a gender 意为“登记性别”，1978 年那位登记员登记了办公室里没有一位办事员肯描述的一项性别。
gender 意为“性别”，指那一条登记本身而不是姓名，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
gender 意为“性别”，指办公室里每一栏旁边的那一栏，每一栏旁边都有同一张矮矮的表格。
gender 意为“性别”，指最远抽屉里留给孩子们填写的那一栏，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gender 意为“性、（语法的）性”，指一件事里人人都填却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这一项就是那件事的全部。
gender 意为“性别身份”，指人人都填却无人提起的那样东西而不是那一条登记，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gender 意为“性别”，指方案里写到、被核对过的那一栏，到 1983 年这一栏成了方案里的一行。
gender 意为“性别”，登记员十一月写道，整件事的性别登记之事是一间办公室和三个学期的描述。
gender 意为“性别”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那一栏，1985 年核对完了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一栏。
gender 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，一项性别登记是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。

那一项性别，指的是那一条登记本身而不是姓名，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。（gender）
那间办公室里每一栏性别旁边都有同一张矮矮的表格。（gender）
最远抽屉里那一栏性别，指的是他们留给孩子们填写的那一栏，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（gender）
叔叔说这一项就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那一条登记。（gender）
1987 年母亲说，一项性别登记是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。（gender）
